ngaap.guidance: Q2-26: core revenue growth +low-single digits (Biotechnology +mid-single digit, Life Sciences up slightly, Diagnostics flat); FX ~+0.5% on sales; corporate expense ~$(90)m; net interest expense ~$(40)m; tax rate ~17.0%; average adjusted diluted shares ~712.0m. FY2026: core revenue growth +3.0% to +6.0% maintained (Biotechnology ~+6.0%, Life Sciences up slightly, Diagnostics +low-single digit); adjusted diluted EPS raised to $8.35-$8.55 (from $8.35-$8.50); adjusted operating profit margin ~26.5%; Cepheid respiratory revenue ~$1.6-1.7bn; FX ~+0.5% on sales; amortization ~$1.7bn; corporate expense ~$(360)m; net interest expense ~$(140)m (excludes Masimo financing); tax rate ~17.0%; average adjusted diluted shares ~714.0m (rates as of 27-Mar-2026). Pending Masimo acquisition (~$9.9bn incl. assumed debt, net of cash; ~$1.5bn 2025 revenue; to be in Diagnostics; agreement 16-Feb-2026).
